description.text: rolls through deep shadow, holding a steady left-to-right course across the width of the scene. Its headlights cut a narrow cone through the gloom, picking out rough concrete walls, faint seams and drifting dust just ahead of the bumper. The car is mostly a dark silhouette at first, with only the leading edges and wheel rims catching a thin sheen from the light spill. Tyres hiss softly on the asphalt while a low engine hum fills the enclosed space and returns off the curved walls. As the seconds pass, the car gathers pace and pulls forward out of the deepest shadow, so more of its shape emerges into the lit foreground: the nose clears the dark pocket, the beam stretches farther down the tunnel, and the concrete brightens in a narrow moving pool. The car keeps travelling left to right, steady and controlled, while the contrast between the unlit distance and the advancing pool of light deepens. Cool air and fine grit hang in the beam, and the wet asphalt throws back a few broken highlights. The movement reads as a deliberate release from the dark rather than a sudden swerve.
